pages.title: Pet Fashion Stylist
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Give rescued animals a makeover in Pet Fashion Stylist. Begin by cleaning their coats and taking them through spa treatments, then choose clothes and accessories for the finished look. Take a photo and collect fashion likes as you compare the pet's style with other entries.

pages.title: A7 Parking Puzzle
pages.creator: FandomWire Marketing Management LLC
pages.description: Plan a scooter's route through a tiled world in A7 Parking Puzzle. Collect keys before approaching the gates they open, then guide the scooter to the finish. Think ahead about turns and dead ends so you can complete each board in fewer moves.

pages.title: Bears vs. Art
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Roll Rory through guarded galleries in Bears vs. Art and tear up the paintings. The bear moves in eight directions, so use the grid to line up each approach. Watch for lasers, spikes, portals and the people protecting or stealing the artwork as you solve the rooms.

pages.title: Dino Hunter King
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Track prehistoric targets in Dino Hunter King. Scan the open grasslands for dinosaurs, line up the hunter's view and drag to adjust your aim before firing. Keep checking the landscape for the next target as you work through the hunting encounters.

pages.title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Explore pyramids, temples and palaces with a Sphinx companion in Wonders of Egypt Match 2. Match at least three jewels to collect treasures and complete each board's goals. Use boosters to reach difficult pieces while progressing through the Ancient Egyptian locations.

pages.title: Zindex
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Scavenge an abandoned infected town in Zindex. Search buildings and containers for the materials needed to craft equipment, then defend yourself from zombies with melee or ranged weapons. Repair the radio tower to call for rescue as you gather what the escape requires.

pages.title: Superheroes and the Wand
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Help a stick figure and unusual heroes confront a sorcerer in Superheroes and the Wand. Follow the on-screen button prompts through the story, then click the aiming mark quickly during fights. React in time to defeat the villain's allies and continue.

pages.title: Wood Block Puzzle 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Place wooden shapes on a ten-by-ten board in Wood Block Puzzle 3. Complete rows or columns to remove blocks, score points and make room for the next shapes. Use the available boosters when an awkward gap prevents a useful placement, then keep working toward a better record.

pages.title: Blox Fruits
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Fight bandits and take on island quests in Blox Fruits. Train your character through battles, equip a sword and seek fruits that grant special powers. Explore more islands as you gain levels and build a stronger set of abilities for the next enemy.

pages.title: Logic Blast Explorer
pages.creator: CheesecakeGames
pages.description: Fit shapes into an eight-by-eight grid in Logic Blast Explorer. Clear complete lines and plan combinations that remove more pieces at once. Work through handcrafted boards, collect landmarks and try boosters or new tile designs as the journey progresses.

pages.title: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle
pages.creator: Joyteractive Limited
pages.description: Decode quotations in Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle by entering the missing letters. Use repeated symbols and the words already revealed to work out the rest of the sentence. Try hints when needed and discover quotes from different literary or inspirational themes.

pages.title: Stick Hero Fight
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Fight incoming groups in Stick Hero Fight. Use punches, weapons and special attacks to keep the stick figure standing as enemies close in. Upgrade the hero between encounters and choose attacks that help you handle the next wave.

pages.title: Chill Clicker
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Click to increase a population of relaxed capybaras in Chill Clicker. Spend the output on upgrades that produce more capybaras, then work toward additional skins and weather changes. Keep building the operation as larger purchases become available.

pages.title: Nuts Bolts Screw Glass
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Remove screws into matching colored boxes in Nuts Bolts Screw Glass. Check which box needs the next screw before selecting it, since unmatched pieces drop into a limited holding groove. Keep that space from filling while dismantling the glass structure.

pages.title: ChessField
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Plan moves across a two-dimensional board in ChessField. The pieces follow chess movement patterns, so a rook travels along straight lines while a bishop uses diagonals. Use those different ranges to decide how to approach the opposing pieces in each battle.

pages.title: Mow It
pages.creator: BOLD CAT
pages.description: Cut grass with a harvester in Mow It and sell the colored hay you collect. Drive around the farm with WASD or the mobile joystick, then use the earnings to continue into new levels. Clear the patches as you build up the harvesting business.

pages.title: Squid Game Memory Card Match
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Reveal pairs of symbols and characters in Squid Game Memory Card Match. Watch where each picture is hidden and use earlier flips to find its partner. Clear the board before the countdown ends, or compare how efficiently you finish with friends.

pages.title: DriftClicker
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Build a faster drift car in DriftClicker. Compete in races to earn keys, open containers for parts and use those finds to improve the vehicle. Keep upgrading as the drifting challenges ask for quicker reactions through each turn.

pages.title: Bottle challenge
pages.creator: Shenzhen haikuo yuntour rede tecnologia co., LTD
pages.description: Measure the requested liquid amounts in Bottle challenge. Look at the volumes of the available containers and plan how to use them to reach each target. Complete the required measures to solve the current pouring puzzle and move on.

pages.title: Nuts & Bolts Wood Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Unscrew the fasteners holding a wooden arrangement together in Nuts & Bolts Wood Puzzle Game. Consider which bolts are supporting each piece before removing one. Work through the order carefully until all the fasteners have been taken out.

pages.title: Zen Tile
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Find triples of identical pictures in Zen Tile. Each chosen tile enters a collecting bar, so make a match before the bar fills with unrelated pieces. Clear the layout and use boosters when a difficult layer hides the tiles you need.

pages.title: Mad Medicine
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Collect useful supplies while running in Mad Medicine. Guide the character around harmful obstacles and pick up first-aid items that improve their fitness in the game's cartoon progression. Reach the final race in better shape to improve your chances of winning.

pages.title: Police Evolution Idle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Patrol the city in Police Evolution Idle. Chase criminals, deal with badly parked cars and manage traffic checkpoints while building your policing operation. Complete duties to unlock additional suspect types and new forms of traffic control around the city.

pages.title: The Last Miner
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Choose a blocky survivor and defend against zombies in The Last Miner. Play thirty missions spread across three maps, with tasks ranging from collecting supplies to holding out against attacks. Buy weapons, skins and accessories as you work through the outbreak.

pages.title: Extreme Runway Racing
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Race along a runway course in Extreme Runway Racing. Learn the bends and keep the car on track as you compete for the finish. Try a solo contest or use the separate controls to challenge a friend in two-player mode.

pages.title: Nubik vs Herobrin's Army
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Rescue a kidnapped brother in Nubik vs Herobrin's Army. Fight through monsters with crafted weapons and drag identical weapons together in the inventory to improve them. Use the stronger equipment to get farther through Herobrine's forces.

pages.title: HexAquatic Kraken
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Connect matching sea creatures across a hexagonal board in HexAquatic Kraken. Drag through at least three identical tiles and focus on the goals needed to finish each puzzle. Follow the underwater journey as you work to defeat the Kraken.

pages.title: Play Time - Toy Horror Store
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Explore three maps with different survival tasks in Play Time - Toy Horror Store. Search for objects, rescue people, fight Huggy Wuggy enemies or find the exit according to the mission. Choose easy, normal or hard difficulty before attempting the escape.

pages.title: 2048 Runner
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Guide a numbered cube through gates in 2048 Runner. Merge with an equal cube and choose positive gates to raise its value, while avoiding incompatible cubes and negative effects. Reach the end with a number at least as high as the stage's target.

pages.title: Cat and Rabbit Holiday
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create festive looks for two animals in Cat and Rabbit Holiday. Choose Christmas or New Year clothes, style their hair and apply gentle makeup. Bring the accessories and outfits together to give both characters a look for the celebration.

pages.title: Bubble Block Breaker
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Keep bubbles bouncing above a platform in Bubble Block Breaker. Tap to launch, then hold and slide the platform beneath each returning bubble. Catch the rebounds to continue clearing the formation and extend the beach-themed arcade run.

pages.title: Match 20 Challenge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Combine matching numbered pieces in Match 20 Challenge and work toward the target value of twenty. Keep watching how the board changes after each combination. Use the opening stages to plan larger merges as higher numbers make space harder to manage.

pages.title: Merge Master Dinosaur Fusion
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Arrange an army before combat in Merge Master Dinosaur Fusion. Combine matching dinosaurs to strengthen the force, then choose where each one stands before starting the fight. Adjust the formation to defeat the computer-controlled army with fewer losses.

pages.title: Gym Shark Woman
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Build strength and fight your way forward in Gym Shark Woman. Use the character's growing muscles to handle enemies and climb walls. Judge each action carefully as you work through the course toward the next challenge.

pages.title: Matching Puzzle Temple
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Turn over cards and remember their pictures in Matching Puzzle Temple. Reveal a pair that matches to clear it, then use what you learned from earlier flips to find the remaining pairs. Keep track of the layout as the stages become more involved.

pages.title: Squid Game 2
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Take on a new set of shipboard survival contests in Squid Game 2. Follow the current challenge's rules and react to its hazards as the competition continues. Work through the events aboard the Pacific vessel and try to remain the final survivor.

pages.title: Arcalona
pages.creator: Eggys Games
pages.description: Develop a home base and an adventuring party in Arcalona. Improve buildings, equip weapons and spend hero upgrades on attributes or the spell tree. Take the party into encounters with more than thirty-six enemy types as you expand its abilities.

pages.title: Santa Claus Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pick one of twelve holiday drawings in Santa Claus Coloring and fill it with your palette. Change the brush size for broad areas or small details, and erase a patch when you want another shade. Save the finished picture once it is complete.

pages.title: Xmasjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Pair identical holiday tiles in Xmasjong to uncover the pieces below. Finish clearing an arrangement to reveal a decoration that joins the Christmas display. Keep solving boards to add more items around the tree.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive through narrow coastal streets in Parking Fury 3D: Beach City. Steal cars and bring them into difficult parking spots while avoiding police attention. Check traffic and turning space before committing to a tight approach.

pages.title: Aliens Vs Math
pages.creator: Polar Games
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions to fire at invaders in Aliens Vs Math. Choose the right results for addition, subtraction, multiplication or division problems and use the laser to stop the attack. Keep solving to build a higher score.

pages.title: Crowd Stack Race 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather runners of the same current color in Crowd Stack Race 3D. Steer the team along the platform and add compatible stick figures to the crowd. Try to carry more members through to the finish for a better result.

pages.title: Aqua Blocks
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Fit three available shapes at a time onto the watery grid in Aqua Blocks. Complete a row or column to clear it and leave room for the next pieces. Use the helper when a crowded arrangement makes it hard to continue.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 9
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Perform aquatic tricks with a trained animal in My Dolphin Show 9. Time jumps and flips to entertain the audience in an Asian-inspired venue. Spend earned coins on outfits such as waterproof kimonos for the next performance.

pages.title: Rugby 2021
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Run with the ball and pass to teammates in Rugby 2021. Swipe to choose the throw and move around defenders or obstacles on the route. Keep possession long enough to bring the team to the destination.

pages.title: Car Defender
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build and improve armed vehicles in Car Defender to withstand waves of attackers. Reinvest gold in higher-level cars that earn more income, giving you room to add further vehicles. Complete tasks while developing the defensive lineup.

pages.title: Figures in the Clouds
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Recognize pictures hidden in cloud outlines in Figures in the Clouds. Compare the cloudy shape with the choices and select the image it resembles. Work through the examples to practice noticing the main silhouette of familiar objects.

pages.title: Pen Run Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slide a pen across a cluttered desk in Pen Run Online. Collect extra pens while steering around books, containers and other stationery. Bring the surviving collection to the notebook at the end of the course.

pages.title: Run Race 3D
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Hold to move and release to wait in Run Race 3D. Time your progress through the parkour course so moving obstacles do not knock the runner back. Beat the other racers and unlock more characters as you finish levels.

pages.title: Happy Glass Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Draw channels that carry water into the cup in Happy Glass Game. Use the surrounding surfaces to support the flow and reach the required fill level. Save ink where possible to earn more stars across eighty puzzles.

pages.title: PaintBall Fun Shooting Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Enter colorful arena battles in PaintBall Fun Shooting Multiplayer. Try five modes, including team deathmatch and gun game, or work through forty offline stages. Move with WASD and use the mouse to aim at opposing players while staying clear of their fire.

pages.title: Tank Fight
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Defend headquarters from successive enemy vehicles in Tank Fight. Drive into a useful firing position and stop attackers before they reach the base. Play alone against the waves or share a tank duel with a friend.

pages.title: Lock Challenge
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Watch the moving marker in Lock Challenge and tap at the moment that opens the lock. Keep your timing accurate as you face another lock after the first. Learn the movement before committing to each attempt.

pages.title: Crazy Chase
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Steer a small car away from pursuing officers in Crazy Chase. Collect coins while looking for turns that separate you from the police. Collisions take health, so keep finding open road to extend the chase and build your score.

pages.title: Little Cute Vehicles Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match three or more vehicle blocks in Little Cute Vehicles Match 3. Keep an eye on the meter at the left and make another match before it drops too low. Use the pieces left behind by one group to find the next.

pages.title: Car Racing
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Choose a car and compete across a five-stage tournament in Car Racing. Learn the layout of each course as you steer through the event. Unlock additional vehicles and levels while working toward a tournament win.

pages.title: Color Numbers
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Fill numbered pixels to reveal pictures in Color Numbers. Select the color assigned to a number and find the squares that use it. Continue through the grid until the individual blocks become a complete piece of pixel art.

pages.title: Advance Bike Parking Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Maneuver motorcycles through tight spaces in Advance Bike Parking Game. Try different machines, including police bikes and quad bikes, as the parking layouts change. Approach the marked spot carefully enough to line up without striking the surrounding obstacles.

pages.title: Honey Drop
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Time the release of a honey drop in Honey Drop. Watch the pot move below the bee and let go when the drop has a clear path into it. Keep helping the bees deliver what they have gathered instead of spilling it.

pages.title: Space War
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Pilot a ship through hostile formations in Space War. Fire at the incoming spacecraft while collecting ammunition, fuel and hearts to keep your craft operating. Use the open areas of the screen to avoid attacks and survive longer.

pages.title: Circle And Line
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Keep a moving ring clear of the line in Circle And Line. Tap to adjust its position as the path passes through it, judging the space around both edges. Maintain the sequence as the pace rises and the margin for error shrinks.

pages.title: FZ Impossible Dash
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Jump a small character past traps in FZ Impossible Dash. Watch the next obstacle and time the leap before the moving course reaches it. Work through the layouts as the required jumps leave less room for a late reaction.

pages.title: Hyper Football Kick Up Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Keep a football in the air in Hyper Football Kick Up Party. Move the circle under the falling ball and make another touch before it escapes. Build a kick-up streak and try to improve the total you recorded on the last attempt.

pages.title: Soccer Shoot 3D
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Launch a football across the environment in Soccer Shoot 3D. Use the direction meter to line up the kick and see how far the ball travels. Spend money from attempts on power, speed, bounce or earnings upgrades for the next shot.

pages.title: Car Reaction!
pages.creator: TopFrivGames
pages.description: Time changes to the moving car in Car Reaction! Watch the other vehicles as they enter its path and tap to keep it clear. Extend the run by reacting before the next collision develops.

pages.title: Monster Truck Port Stunt
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Cross a port built from shipping containers in Monster Truck Port Stunt. Adjust your speed for tilted surfaces and watch for traps along the route. Use the separate controls to guide the trucks across the narrow course.

pages.title: Real Impossible Tracks Race
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a sports car along elevated roads in Real Impossible Tracks Race. Slow down for sharp turns and keep the vehicle lined up through obstacle sections. Unlock more cars as you learn how to finish the difficult tracks.

pages.title: Ultimate Jump Cube
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Leap between platforms in Ultimate Jump Cube. Time each click to carry the cube across the next gap and collect the colored cubes along the way. Keep choosing landings that allow the run to continue.

pages.title: Airplane Fight
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Steer a combat plane through attacking aircraft in Airplane Fight. Aim and fire while moving out of the way of the enemies crossing the sky. Keep the plane in clear space as you work through the next wave.

pages.title: Ball Challenge
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Switch a ball between the upper and lower paths in Ball Challenge. Watch the obstacles before tapping to change sides and collect points along the route. Break useful power-ups to help the ball stay in play.

pages.title: Dark Village
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Shoot approaching undead in Dark Village. Pick targets as they appear and keep firing before they can overwhelm your position. Follow the action around the village and try to last through the attack.

pages.title: Winter Soccer
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pull back and release players to strike the ball in Winter Soccer. Choose one of thirty-two nations and try to be first to score three goals against the computer. Plan around both defenders and the direction the next shot will travel.

pages.title: Checkpoint Run
pages.creator: PulseNova
pages.description: Drive through city and hillside circuits in Checkpoint Run. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer and the space bar for the handbrake. Learn the course's tighter turns as you race through the checkpoints.

pages.title: Zombie Typing
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Type the words beneath incoming enemies in Zombie Typing. Completing a word kills its zombie before it can reach you. Work quickly between targets and keep the remaining health from being drained by attackers who get too close.

pages.title: Bullet Fire
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Clear hostile fighters from the map in Bullet Fire. Move into position to get a clear shot, then keep checking the surrounding area for enemies. Finish the attack as quickly as you can while staying alive.

pages.title: Blurst
pages.creator: ugotgames.com
pages.description: Read each screen's instruction before bursting shapes in Blurst. Use the mouse or finger to select only the objects the current rule allows. Adapt as the target changes instead of continuing to hit the same kind of shape.

pages.title: Pixel Reaction
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Start a spreading chain reaction in Pixel Reaction. Click a position to create a larger pixel and catch passing colored pieces as it expands. Predict their movement so your starting point reaches as many as possible.

pages.title: Mermaid Halloween Parties
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Ariel prepare five different costumes in Mermaid Halloween Parties. Each invitation comes with its own theme, so choose a look that suits that party before moving to the next. Coordinate the outfits and accessories for her busy Halloween schedule.

pages.title: Ladybug Halloween Hairstyles
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create spooky hairstyles in Ladybug Halloween Hairstyles. Work through looks such as a knotted ponytail or braided spider bun, using the tools to shape the hair. Finish the chosen design before Ladybug heads to the celebration.

pages.title: Animal Shapes 3
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fit animal pieces into their outlines in Animal Shapes 3. Look at the silhouettes and compare the parts before dragging each one into place. Complete the picture to reveal the animal and move to another arrangement.

pages.title: Pac Rat
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Eat cheese throughout a maze in Pac Rat. Guide the mouse along the corridors while keeping track of the cats trying to catch it. Choose another turn when a cat blocks the route to the remaining food.

pages.title: Diet Flappy HTML5 Bird
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guide a yellow bird home in Diet Flappy HTML5 Bird. Avoid poles and hostile birds, and think carefully about collecting food that changes the bird's size and speed. Use the separate flight and movement controls to thread the route.

pages.title: Cooking Challenge
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate desserts for two princesses in Cooking Challenge. Choose chocolate, sweets and syrup details to turn plain doughnuts into contest entries. Finish a distinct plate for each competitor before comparing their designs.

pages.title: Block Shooter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Blast through numbered barriers in Block Shooter as you travel toward Earth. Aim at the blocks that obstruct the ship and use improvements for the craft and its guns. Keep breaking a route through the long journey.

pages.title: Merge 2048
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Place matching pieces beside one another in Merge 2048. Groups of three combine into the next value, so leave space to bring another matching tile alongside. Continue building larger pieces until you can make the 2048 tile.

pages.title: Selena Gomez Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Try three singer-inspired looks in Selena Gomez Hairstyles. Follow the styling steps to prepare the hair, then shape it into the selected design. Compare the finished styles and choose the one you want the character to wear.

pages.title: Sery Shopping Day Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Put together an outfit before a trip to the shops in Sery Shopping Day Dress Up. Mix tops and bottoms, then choose shoes and accessories to finish the look. Complete the achievements as you experiment with Sery's wardrobe.

pages.title: Ice Skating Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a mother and daughter for their event in Ice Skating Contest. Start with the princess's skating costume, then choose one for the younger skater. Coordinate the accessories before both take to the rink.

pages.title: Brave Bull Pirates
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help a bull reach his captured sweetheart in Brave Bull Pirates. Work out how the objects in each scene can clear a path past the pirates. Solve the stages efficiently to bring the pair back together.

pages.title: Ice Skating Competition
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two royal skaters in Ice Skating Competition. Pick a costume for the princess, then dress her daughter for the same event. Try coordinating colors and accessories so both are ready for their performance.

pages.title: Eliza Sale Rush
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Visit the mall with a princess in Eliza Sale Rush. Help Eliza choose outfits from the discounted clothing and compare pieces before deciding what to buy. Work with her friends to finish the shopping trip.

pages.title: Girls Christmas Party Prep!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress Ellie, Annie and Belle for a seasonal gathering in Girls Christmas Party Prep! Choose clothes and accessories for each friend and bring their individual looks together. Finish the outfits before the winter celebration begins.

pages.title: Ellie Fashion Magazine
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Style a model for three covers in Ellie Fashion Magazine. Choose clothing, accessories and hair details that suit each publication's look. Give Ellie a different outfit for every photo instead of repeating the same cover design.
